lessons.topic: Rules at work: must, have to, can — правила на работе
lessons.description: Работа и правила: must и have to, mustn't и don't have to, can / can't; прогнозы о работе будущего с will, will probably и might. Чтение, аудирование, лексика о работе.
lessons.goal: Рассказать о правилах и обязанностях на работе и в школе, не путая mustn't и don't have to, и сделать прогноз о работе будущего
lessons.bookRef: по мотивам Unit 5A–5C: must / have to / can, will и might; тексты и записи написаны для урока

blocks.title: Повторение урока 7: планы и прогнозы
paragraphs: Вспомним три способа говорить о будущем из прошлого урока.
rules: Present Continuous — договорённость: I'm flying to Rome on Friday.
be going to — намерение и прогноз по фактам: I'm going to learn Spanish. Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.
will — решение на ходу, обещание, прогноз; после if / when — Present Simple: If it rains, we'll stay at home.

tasks.prompt: Выберите вариант: Look at the sky! It ___ rain.
tasks.explanation: Прогноз по тому, что видим сейчас — be going to.

tasks.prompt: Впишите will или won't: — I can't carry this bag. — Don't worry, I ___ help you.
Выберите вариант: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
Впишите Present Continuous (leave): Our train ___ at 8 am tomorrow — I've already bought the tickets.
tasks.explanation: Договорённость с точным временем — Present Continuous: is leaving.

blocks.title: Разогрев: работа и правила
paragraphs: Обсудите с преподавателем по-английски. Используйте must, have to и can.
prompts: Which jobs do you think are exciting or dangerous? Why?
What rules do you have to follow at school or at work?
Would you like to work from home? Why (not)?
What job would you like to have in the future?
blocks.sample: I think the job of a firefighter is both exciting and dangerous, because firefighters have to go into burning buildings. At school I have to wear a uniform on Mondays and I mustn't use my phone during lessons, but I can use it in the break. I'd like to work from home sometimes, because I wouldn't have to travel to work. In the future I'd like to be an engineer. I'll probably study at a technical university.

blocks.title: Чтение: The coolest jobs
paragraphs: Прочитайте три рассказа о работе. Подчеркните все модальные глаголы (must, have to, can…) и решите, что они выражают: необходимость, запрет, отсутствие необходимости или разрешение.
blocks.text:
The coolest jobs (three people tell us about their work)

Marta, 28 - ski instructor in Austria
'I teach children and adults to ski. I have to get up at 6 am because the first lesson starts at 8. Safety is very important, so we must check the equipment every morning, and visitors mustn't go on the mountain without a helmet. I don't have to wear a uniform, but I can choose my own jacket. The best thing? I can ski every day for free!'

Daniel, 35 - zookeeper in England
'My day starts with feeding the animals. We have to wash our hands and boots before we go into some areas, and visitors can't touch the animals. I don't have to work at weekends, but I often do, because the animals need food every day. It's hard work, but I can watch baby animals grow up.'

Kim, 24 - video game tester in Korea
'People think I just play games all day, but I have to write long reports about every mistake I find. I can work from home two days a week, and I don't have to wear a suit. But I mustn't tell anyone about the new games - it's a secret!'

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст и выберите ответ: Why do ski instructors check the equipment every morning?
options: It is a rule of the hotel
optionValues: It is a rule of the hotel
tasks.explanation: Safety is very important, so we must check the equipment every morning.

tasks.prompt: Выберите ответ: What can Marta do for free?
tasks.explanation: I can ski every day for free!

tasks.prompt: Впишите слово из текста: Visitors ___ touch the animals in the zoo.
tasks.explanation: Visitors can't touch the animals — правило запрещает.

tasks.prompt: Впишите слово из текста (не обязательно): Daniel ___ work at weekends, but he often does.
tasks.answer: doesn't have to, does not have to
tasks.explanation: I don't have to work at weekends — работать не обязан.

tasks.prompt: Выберите ответ: What does Kim have to do?
tasks.explanation: I have to write long reports about every mistake I find.

tasks.prompt: Выберите ответ: Where can Kim work two days a week?
tasks.explanation: I can work from home two days a week.

blocks.title: Правило 1: must и have to — необходимость
paragraphs: Must и have to переводятся «должен», но используются по-разному. Must — личное решение говорящего или строгое правило, have to — внешняя необходимость: расписание, закон, начальник. У must нет прошедшего и будущего — их заменяет have to.
formulas:
must + V1: сильная необходимость

+  You must show your passport.
?  Must I fill in this form? (в вопросах чаще: Do I have to fill in…?)
После must — глагол без to: You must go. Не «must to go».

have to / has to + V1: внешняя необходимость

+  I have to wear a uniform. · She has to get up early.
?  Do you have to wear a uniform? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Прошедшее: had to — Yesterday I had to wait for two hours.
Будущее: will have to — Next year you will have to pass an exam.
rules: must — решение говорящего или строгое правило: You must be at the gate at 7. I must call my mum.
have to — необходимость «извне»: расписание, закон, начальник: I have to work on Saturday. He has to wear a helmet.
У must нет прошедшего времени: вчера — had to: Yesterday I had to wait for two hours. Не «I musted».
В будущем — will have to: Next year you will have to pass an exam.

tasks.prompt: Выберите слово: Passengers ___ show their passports at the border.
tasks.explanation: После must — глагол без to и без окончания.

tasks.prompt: Впишите have to или has to: My sister ___ get up at 6 am on school days.
Впишите have to в прошедшем времени: Yesterday we ___ wait for two hours at the airport.
tasks.explanation: Прошедшее время от have to — had to.

tasks.prompt: Выберите вариант: Next year I ___ take the exam.
tasks.explanation: У must нет будущего — will have to.

tasks.prompt: В каком предложении ошибка?
options: I musted call my boss yesterday.
She has to wear a uniform.
optionValues: I musted call my boss yesterday.
She has to wear a uniform.
tasks.answer: I musted call my boss yesterday.
tasks.explanation: У must нет прошедшего времени: надо I had to call.

tasks.prompt: Впишите слово: ___ you have to get up early on Sundays?
tasks.explanation: Вопрос с have to строится с do / does: Do you have to…?

blocks.title: Аудирование: три человека рассказывают о своей работе
paragraphs: Послушайте три коротких рассказа о работе (запись озвучена нейросетевым голосом). Ответьте на вопросы.
blocks.transcript:
Speaker 1: I work as a lifeguard at a swimming pool. I have to be at the pool at seven in the morning, and I mustn't leave my chair when people are swimming. We don't have to wear a uniform, but we must wear a whistle. I can't use my phone during work, but I can swim in my lunch break.
Speaker 2: I'm a chef in a small Italian restaurant. In the kitchen we have to wash our hands every half an hour, and we must wear a white hat. I don't have to work on Mondays, because the restaurant is closed. The hardest thing is that I can't sit down for ten hours!
Speaker 3: I'm a primary school teacher. I have to prepare lessons every evening, and I must be polite to parents. Children mustn't run in the corridors, so I have to watch them in the breaks. The good thing is that I don't have to work in the summer. We have long holidays.

tasks.prompt: Где работает первый говорящий?
tasks.explanation: I work as a lifeguard at a swimming pool.

tasks.prompt: Во сколько первый говорящий должен начинать работу?
tasks.explanation: I have to be at the pool at seven in the morning.

tasks.prompt: Впишите слово: The lifeguard ___ use her phone during work.
tasks.explanation: I can't use my phone during work.

tasks.prompt: Что повар обязан надевать?
tasks.explanation: We must wear a white hat.

tasks.prompt: Почему повар не обязан работать по понедельникам?
tasks.explanation: I don't have to work on Mondays, because the restaurant is closed.

tasks.prompt: Впишите слово: The teacher ___ work in the summer — there are long holidays.
tasks.answer: doesn't have to, does not have to
tasks.explanation: I don't have to work in the summer.

blocks.title: Правило 2: mustn't, don't have to, can и can't
paragraphs: Mustn't и don't have to звучат похоже, но значат разное: mustn't — «нельзя» (запрет), don't have to — «не нужно» (можно не делать, но и делать не запрещено). Can и can't говорят о том, что правила разрешают или не разрешают.
formulas:
mustn't + V1: запрет

You mustn't take photos in the museum. (нельзя)
You mustn't be late for the flight. (нельзя опаздывать)

don't / doesn't have to + V1: не нужно

You don't have to pay — it's free. (платить не нужно)
She doesn't have to wear a tie. (галстук не обязателен)
Прошедшее: didn't have to — Yesterday I didn't have to get up early.

can / can't: разрешено и не разрешено

You can bring your own lunch. (разрешено)
You can't use your phone in the lab. (не разрешено)
Employees are allowed to wear jeans on Fridays. = Employees can wear jeans on Fridays.
rules: mustn't — действие запрещено, делать нельзя: You mustn't use your phone during the exam.
don't have to — действие не обязательно, но не запрещено: You don't have to book a table, there are lots of free ones.
can — правило разрешает, can't — правило не разрешает: Visitors can't touch the animals.
Не переводите don't have to как «нельзя» — это самая частая ошибка.

tasks.prompt: Знак «No photos». Выберите вариант: You ___ take photos here.
Вход бесплатный. Выберите вариант: You ___ pay to enter.
tasks.explanation: Платить не нужно — don't have to.

tasks.prompt: Впишите mustn't: You ___ run in the corridor — it's dangerous.
Впишите don't have to: It's Sunday, so I ___ get up early.
tasks.answer: don't have to, do not have to
tasks.explanation: Вставать рано не нужно — нет необходимости.

tasks.prompt: Какое предложение значит «Можно не приходить»?
Выберите вариант: In this office you ___ wear jeans on Fridays — it's allowed.

blocks.title: Правило 3: will, might и probably — прогнозы о работе будущего
paragraphs: О будущем работы мы можем говорить с разной уверенностью. Will — мы уверены, will probably — скорее всего, might — возможно, но не уверены.
formulas:
Уверенность в прогнозе

will / won't — почти наверняка: Robots will do many boring jobs. · Machines won't replace teachers.
will probably — скорее всего: Many people will probably work from home.
might / might not — возможно: Some jobs might disappear. · We might not need offices.

Порядок слов

probably стоит после will и перед not-формой won't: We will probably… · We probably won't…
might — одна форма для всех лиц: I / he / they might go.
После will и might — глагол без to: It might change. Не «might to change».
rules: will — мы уверены: In 2050 people will use even more technology.
will probably — вероятно: Most students will probably use AI to learn languages.
might — возможно (шансов около 50%): I might become a pilot.
Отрицание: won't — «точно нет», might not — «возможно, нет»: I might not get the job.

tasks.prompt: Выберите вариант: In the future, robots ___ do dangerous jobs. (мы уверены)
Выберите вариант: I'm not sure, but we ___ work four days a week in the future. (возможно)
Впишите will probably: Many people ___ work from home in 2040.
Впишите might not (exist): Some jobs ___ in twenty years.
tasks.explanation: Возможно, не будет — might not + V1.

tasks.prompt: Какое предложение значит «Точно не случится»?
options: Robots will probably take all jobs.
optionValues: Robots will probably take all jobs.

tasks.prompt: В каком предложении ошибка?

blocks.title: Лексика: work and jobs
paragraphs: Слова для разговора о работе. Составьте с каждым предложение с must, have to, can или will.

blocks.title: Произношение: can и can't, слабые формы must и have to
paragraphs: В живой речи модальные глаголы звучат короче, чем пишутся. Русская подсказка в скобках — приблизительное чтение; точные звуки показывает транскрипция.
formulas:
can и can't: главное отличие

I can swim /aɪ kən swɪm/ (ай кэн свим) — can звучит слабо, почти не слышно
I can't swim /aɪ kænt swɪm/ (ай кэнт свим) — can't звучит ударно и с полным звуком /æ/
На слух их различают по ударению: can /kən/ (кэн) — can't /kænt/ (кэнт).

have to, has to и must в быстрой речи

I have to go /aɪ ˈhæf tə ɡoʊ/ (ай хэ́ф тэ го́у) — have to звучит как «хэфтэ»
She has to work /ʃi ˈhæs tə wɜːrk/ (ши хэ́с тэ уёрк) — has to звучит как «хэстэ»
mustn't /ˈmʌsnt/ (ма́снт) — первая t не читается

Слова урока: ударение

colleague /ˈkɑːliːɡ/ (ка́лиг) — на первом слоге
salary /ˈsæləri/ (сэ́лэри) — на первом слоге
career /kəˈrɪr/ (кэри́р) — на втором слоге
apply /əˈplaɪ/ (эпла́й) — на втором слоге
qualification /ˌkwɑːlɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (куалификэ́йшн) — на предпоследнем слоге
overtime /ˈoʊvərtaɪm/ (о́увэртайм) — на первом слоге

tasks.prompt: В каком слове ударение на втором слоге?
Какая форма звучит ударно и с полным звуком /æ/?
tasks.explanation: can't /kænt/ (кэнт): ударное, с полным гласным. can в потоке речи слабое.

tasks.prompt: Как в быстрой речи часто звучит have to в предложении I have to go?
tasks.explanation: have to → hafta /ˈhæftə/ (хэ́фтэ): так говорят, но пишем have to.

tasks.prompt: Где ударение в слове qualification?
Какое слово читается /ˈmʌsnt/ (ма́снт)?

blocks.title: Говорение: правила на работе и в школе
paragraphs: Расскажите о правилах: на воображаемой работе или в вашей школе. Используйте must / have to, mustn't, don't have to, can / can't.
prompts: What do you have to do every day at school or at work?
What mustn't you do there? Why?
What don't you have to do, but some people do?
What can you do there that you can't do at home?
blocks.sample: At my school we have to wear a uniform and we must be in class by 8:30. We mustn't use phones during lessons, because they disturb other students. We don't have to stay at school after lessons, but many students go to clubs. At school I can use the library and the sports hall, and I can talk to my friends in the break. At home I can't use such a big library! I'm happy that I don't have to wear a uniform at the weekend.

words.example: My colleagues and I have lunch together.
words.definition: a person that you work with
words.definitionRu: человек, с которым вы работаете

words.example: My boss lets me work from home on Fridays.
words.definition: the person who is in charge of other workers
words.definitionRu: человек, который руководит другими работниками

words.example: She has a good salary and a nice office.
words.definition: money that you receive every month for your job
words.definitionRu: деньги, которые вы получаете каждый месяц за работу

words.example: I'm working the night shift this week.
words.definition: a period of time when a group of workers are at work
words.definitionRu: время, когда группа работников находится на работе

words.example: He has a full-time job in a bank.
words.definition: for the whole of the normal working week
words.definitionRu: на весь обычный рабочий день

words.example: She has a part-time job in a café.
words.definition: for only part of the working week
words.definitionRu: только на часть рабочего дня

words.example: I want to apply for a job at the zoo.
words.definition: to ask formally for a job
words.definitionRu: официально попросить о работе

words.example: You need a qualification to be a pilot.
words.definition: an exam or a course that you have passed
words.definitionRu: экзамен или курс, который вы прошли

words.example: Safety rules are very important in a factory.
words.definition: the state of being safe
words.definitionRu: состояние, когда вам ничего не угрожает

words.example: The waiters wear a black uniform.
words.definition: special clothes that people wear for their job or at school
words.definitionRu: специальная одежда для работы или для школы

words.example: She wants a career in medicine.
words.definition: the job or jobs that you do during your working life
words.definitionRu: работа или работы, которыми вы занимаетесь всю жизнь

words.example: I did two hours of overtime yesterday.
words.definition: extra hours that you work after your normal hours
words.definitionRu: дополнительные часы работы после обычных

homework.intro: Правила на работе: must и have to, mustn't, don't have to, can / can't; прогнозы с will и might; лексика о работе; аудирование и чтение.

tasks.prompt: Впишите must: Passengers ___ keep their passports in a safe place.
Впишите have to или has to: My brother ___ wear a uniform at work.

tasks.prompt: Выберите вариант: Next month she ___ move to a new flat.

tasks.explanation: Платить не нужно — don't have to.

tasks.prompt: Выберите вариант: Employees ___ use the staff car park, but visitors can't.

Впишите might not (finish): I ___ the project today — I'm very tired.

tasks.prompt: Выберите вариант: It's possible that he ___ the job.

Какой вариант выражает полную уверенность?

Впишите слово по-английски (коллега — 1 слово): I often have lunch with my ___.

Прослушайте запись и выберите ответ: What must Tom wear?
tasks.transcript:
Manager: Welcome to Blue Wave Café, Tom. Let me explain the rules. You have to arrive ten minutes before your shift, and you must wear the blue uniform.
Tom: Do I have to bring my own apron?
Manager: No, you don't have to. We give you one. But you mustn't use your phone in the kitchen. If you want to call someone, you can do it in your break.
Tom: How long is the break?
Manager: Thirty minutes. You can have a free lunch, but you can't take food home.
Tom: OK. And what about weekends?
Manager: You have to work every second Saturday, but you don't have to work on Sundays. Next week you will probably start at nine.
Tom: Great. I think I'll enjoy it.
tasks.explanation: You must wear the blue uniform.

tasks.prompt: Прослушайте запись и выберите ответ: Does Tom have to bring his own apron?
tasks.explanation: No, you don't have to. We give you one.

tasks.prompt: Прослушайте запись и впишите слово: Tom mustn't use his phone in the ___.
tasks.explanation: You mustn't use your phone in the kitchen.

tasks.prompt: Прослушайте запись и впишите ответ по-английски (1 слово): How long is the break, in minutes?
Прослушайте запись и выберите ответ: Which day doesn't Tom have to work?
tasks.explanation: You don't have to work on Sundays.

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст и выберите ответ: What must a receptionist be able to do?
tasks.text:
Sunny Beach Hotel is looking for summer staff

Receptionist (full-time)
You must speak good English and you have to be polite and friendly. You don't have to have a qualification, but you must be over 18. You will work in shifts: the morning shift is 7 am - 3 pm and the evening shift is 3 pm - 11 pm. You can choose your shift, but you can't change it after Monday. The salary is 800 euros a month, and you will probably get extra money for overtime.

Lifeguard (part-time)
You must have a first aid qualification. You have to watch the swimmers carefully and you mustn't leave your place on the beach. You don't have to wear a uniform, but you must wear a red hat. Lifeguards can swim in their free time.

Staff rules
You mustn't use your phone in the lobby, and you have to wash your hands before you work in the kitchen.

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст выше и впишите слово (не нужно): Receptionists ___ have a qualification.
tasks.answer: don't have to, do not have to
tasks.explanation: You don't have to have a qualification.

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст выше и впишите слово (нельзя): Lifeguards ___ leave their place on the beach.
tasks.explanation: You mustn't leave your place on the beach.

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст выше. What time does the evening shift finish?
tasks.explanation: The evening shift is 3 pm - 11 pm.

tasks.prompt: Прочитайте текст выше. What must a lifeguard wear?
tasks.explanation: You must wear a red hat.

tasks.prompt: Напишите на английском (6–8 предложений) о правилах в вашей школе или на воображаемой работе: что вы должны делать (must или have to), что нельзя (mustn't), что делать не обязательно (don't have to) и что можно (can). Закончите одним предложением о будущем с will или might.
tasks.explanation: At my school we have to wear a uniform and we must be in class by 8:30. We mustn't use our phones during lessons, and we can't eat in the classroom. We don't have to stay at school after lessons, but I often go to the English club. We can use the library for free. I think schools will probably have less homework in the future, and students might study at home more often.

tasks.explanation: My dream job is a travel photographer. I would have to travel a lot and take hundreds of photos. I wouldn't have to wear a suit or work in an office, and I could choose my projects. I think I will probably need a qualification in photography, and I might work for a magazine. I can already take good photos with my phone, so I'm going to practise every weekend.

blocks.title: Повторение урока 8: правила на работе

rules: must / have to — необходимо; mustn't — нельзя; don't have to — не нужно; can / can't — можно / нельзя.
will — мы уверены; will probably — скорее всего; might — возможно.
have to меняется по временам: had to (прошедшее), will have to (будущее).

blocks.title: Разогрев: проблемы и советы

blocks.sample: Students often have too much homework and not enough free time. When I have a problem, I usually ask my older sister, because she is very wise. The best advice I've ever received was: don't wait until the last minute. When I have too much work, I make a list and start with the most difficult task.

blocks.title: Чтение: How to improve your English
paragraphs: Прочитайте советы для изучающих английский. Подчеркните все советы: приказания (Speak…, Don't learn…) и конструкции со should / ought to / had better.
blocks.text:
How to improve your English: advice for learners (a wiki page)

Problem 1: 'I understand a lot, but I can't speak.'
Speak every day, even if you make mistakes. Don't be afraid! You should find a speaking partner, and you should record yourself - listening to your own voice helps a lot. Try to think in English when you walk to school.

Problem 2: 'I forget new words very quickly.'
Don't learn long lists of words. You shouldn't try to remember twenty words at once - five is enough. Write each word in a sentence, and repeat it after one day, one week and one month. You ought to keep a small notebook with you.

Problem 3: 'I get nervous in exams.'
Sleep well before the exam and don't study all night. You'd better arrive early, and you shouldn't drink too much coffee. Remember: a few mistakes are OK!

blocks.title: Правило 1: Imperative и should — советы
paragraphs: Для совета в английском есть несколько способов. Повелительное наклонение звучит как дружеский совет (Take a break!), should — мягкий совет, ought to — то же, но чуть книжнее, had better — совет с предупреждением.
formulas:
Imperative: V1 / Don't + V1

Take a break and go for a walk. · Don't worry! · Be careful!
Be в императиве: Be quiet! · Don't be late!

should, ought to, had better + V1

+  You should drink more water. · You ought to see a doctor.
−  You shouldn't eat so much sugar.
?  Should I call her? — Yes, you should.
You'd better hurry, or you'll miss the train. · You'd better not be late.
rules: Imperative — прямой совет без подлежащего: Sleep well before the exam.
should — самый частый способ дать совет: You should talk to your teacher.
ought to — как should: You ought to apologise. had better — с предупреждением: You'd better not forget your passport.
После should и had better — глагол без to: You should go. После ought — to + глагол: You ought to go.

tasks.prompt: Выберите совет: You have a headache.
options: Take a rest and drink water.
optionValues: Take a rest and drink water.
tasks.answer: Take a rest and drink water.

tasks.prompt: Впишите should (see): You've had this cough for weeks. You ___ a doctor.
Впишите shouldn't (eat): You ___ so many sweets — they're bad for your teeth.
Выберите вариант: ___ late for the interview!
Впишите ought to (apologise): You were rude. You ___ to her.
tasks.answer: ought to apologise, ought to apologize

tasks.prompt: Впишите had better (take): It's raining. You ___ an umbrella.
tasks.answer: 'd better take, had better take, d better take
tasks.explanation: had better + V1: совет с предупреждением.

blocks.title: Аудирование: Анна просит совета у друга
paragraphs: Послушайте разговор Анны и Макса (запись озвучена нейросетевым голосом). Ответьте на вопросы.
blocks.audioTitle: Анна и Макс: совет перед экзаменом
blocks.transcript:
Max: Hi Anna, you look tired. What's the matter?
Anna: I didn't sleep well. I have an English speaking exam on Friday and I'm really nervous.
Max: Oh, I understand. What are you worried about?
Anna: I always forget words when I speak, and my pronunciation isn't good.
Max: Well, you should practise every day. Why don't you record yourself on your phone and listen to it?
Anna: That's a good idea. But I don't have much time. I have football training on Tuesday and Thursday.
Max: You'd better not miss the training, you need sport. But you could study for ten minutes before bed.
Anna: OK. And what about sleep? Tonight I'm going to stay up and study.
Max: No, don't do that! You shouldn't stay up late. Go to bed early, and try not to drink coffee.
Anna: You're right. Thanks, Max. Shall we practise together tomorrow after school?
Max: Sure! Let's meet at four at the library.

tasks.prompt: О чём волнуется Анна?
tasks.explanation: I have an English speaking exam on Friday and I'm really nervous.

tasks.prompt: Когда у неё экзамен?
Что Макс советует делать каждый день?
Впишите слово: Max says: «You ___ stay up late.»
Впишите слово, которым Анна предлагает позаниматься вместе: ___ we practise together tomorrow?
tasks.explanation: Shall we…? — предложение сделать что-то вместе.

tasks.prompt: Где они встретятся?
tasks.explanation: Let's meet at four at the library.

blocks.title: Правило 2: просим совета, даём совет, предлагаем помощь
paragraphs: Эти фразы нужны в разговоре: как попросить совет, как его дать мягко и как предложить помощь или совместное действие.
formulas:
Просим совета

What should I do? · Can you give me some advice? · What do you think I should do?
advice — неисчисляемое: some advice, a piece of advice (не «an advice»).

Даём совет

I think you should… · You could… · Why don't you…? · Have you thought about…?
You'd better… (если дело серьёзное) · Don't worry about it.

Предлагаем и откликаемся

Shall I…? (предложить помощь): Shall I carry your bag?
Shall we… / Let's… / How about…? / Why don't we…? (предложить сделать вместе)
Ответ: Good idea! · Yes, let's. · Sorry, I can't.
rules: Why don't you + V1 — мягкий совет: Why don't you ask your teacher?
Have you thought about + -ing: Have you thought about moving to a smaller flat?
Shall I / Shall we — предложение (в вопросах только с I и we): Shall I help you?
How about + -ing / существительное: How about going for a walk?

tasks.prompt: Выберите фразу, которой просят совета:
tasks.explanation: What should I do? — вопрос-просьба о совете.

tasks.prompt: Выберите вариант: ___ you call her and say sorry?
Впишите слово: How ___ going for a walk?
Впишите слово: ___ I help you with your bags?
Какой ответ подходит на предложение «Let's have a pizza»?
tasks.explanation: На предложение отвечают согласием: Good idea! / Yes, let's.

tasks.prompt: Выберите слово: Have you thought ___ talking to your teacher?

blocks.title: Правило 3: глаголы с предлогами
paragraphs: Многие английские глаголы всегда идут с определённым предлогом. Эти пары нужно запоминать вместе. После предлога глагол ставится в форму -ing.
formulas:
Часто встречающиеся пары

worry about · depend on · listen to · wait for · look for · ask for · talk to / about · think about · laugh at · agree with · pay for

После предлога — -ing

I'm thinking about changing my job. · She's worried about failing the exam. · Thanks for helping me!
rules: worry about, think about, talk about — о чём: Don't worry about it.
listen to, talk to — кому: Please listen to me carefully.
wait for, look for, ask for, pay for — за чем: I'm waiting for a call.
depend on, laugh at, agree with — как в русском запоминаем целиком: It depends on the weather. I agree with you.

tasks.prompt: Выберите предлог: Don't worry ___ the exam. You'll be fine.
Выберите предлог: I'm waiting ___ a call from my boss.
tasks.explanation: wait for — ждать кого-то или чего-то.

tasks.prompt: Впишите предлог: It depends ___ the weather.
Впишите предлог: Please listen ___ me carefully.
Выберите предлог: She is looking ___ her keys. She can't find them.
Выберите предлог: We laughed ___ his joke.

blocks.title: Лексика: problems and advice
paragraphs: Слова для разговора о проблемах и советах. Составьте с каждым предложение, где это возможно, со should или Why don't you…?

blocks.title: Произношение: звуки /uː/ и /ʊ/
paragraphs: Короткий /ʊ/ и долгий /uː/ — в одной теме: should и choose, look и school. Русская подсказка в скобках — приблизительное чтение; точные звуки показывает транскрипция.
formulas:
Короткий /ʊ/ (как очень короткое «у»)

should /ʃʊd/ (шуд) · good /ɡʊd/ (гуд) · book /bʊk/ (бук) · look /lʊk/ (лук) · put /pʊt/ (пут)

Долгий /uː/ (протяжное «у-у»)

choose /tʃuːz/ (чуз) · school /skuːl/ (скул) · true /truː/ (тру) · too /tuː/ (ту) · soon /suːn/ (сун)

Слова урока: ударение

advice /ədˈvaɪs/ (эдва́йс) — на втором слоге
solution /səˈluːʃn/ (сэлу́шн) — на втором слоге
suggest /səˈdʒest/ (сэдже́ст) — на втором слоге
nervous /ˈnɜːrvəs/ (не́рвэс) — на первом слоге
stressed /strest/ (стрест) — один слог

tasks.prompt: В каком слове долгий звук /uː/?
tasks.explanation: school /skuːl/ (скул) — долгий /uː/. В book, should, good — короткий /ʊ/.

tasks.prompt: В каком слове короткий звук /ʊ/?

blocks.title: Говорение: дайте совет
paragraphs: Дайте совет другу с проблемой. Используйте should, shouldn't, had better, Why don't you…?, императив и Shall I…?
prompts: A friend can't sleep before an exam. What would you say?
A friend has too much homework. How can you help?
A friend is nervous about a speaking exam in English. What should he or she do?
What advice would you give to a new student at your school?
blocks.sample: If my friend can't sleep before an exam, I'd say: you should go to bed early and you shouldn't drink coffee in the evening. Don't study all night! If he has too much homework, why don't you make a plan? Start with the hardest task. Shall I help you? And if he's nervous about a speaking exam, he should practise every day and record himself. You'd better not worry too much. A few mistakes are OK.

tasks.transcript:
Presenter: Welcome to Teen Talk. Our first caller today is Kate. Kate, what's your problem?
Kate: Hello. My problem is that I'm always tired in the morning. I go to bed at midnight because I play computer games, and then I can't get up for school.
Presenter: I see. Well, Kate, you should turn off your computer at ten o'clock. And don't play games in bed. Why don't you read a book instead?
Kate: I've tried, but I don't like reading.
Presenter: Then listen to music or a podcast. And you'd better not drink cola in the evening, because it has a lot of sugar.
Kate: OK. Shall I put my phone in another room?
Presenter: Good idea! That's the best advice today. Thank you for calling, Kate.

tasks.text:
A message to the 'Ask Emma' advice column

Dear Emma,
I'm 15 and I have a problem with my best friend, Lisa. Last week she told my secret to other students, and now everybody knows it. I'm very angry and sad. I don't want to talk to her, but I'm afraid I'll lose her as a friend. What should I do?
Sam

Emma's answer:
Dear Sam, I understand how you feel. First, don't be angry for too long: it won't help you. You should talk to Lisa and tell her how you feel. Ask her why she did it - maybe it was a mistake. If she says sorry, you ought to forgive her, but next time you'd better not tell her any secrets. Be patient, and good luck!
Emma
options: His friend told his secret to other students
He moved to a new school

tasks.prompt: Ваш друг пишет: «I have too much homework and I'm always tired. What should I do?» Напишите ему ответ на английском (7–9 предложений): посочувствуйте, дайте 3–4 совета (should, shouldn't, had better, Why don't you…?, императив) и предложите помощь (Shall I…?).
tasks.explanation: Hi Alex! I'm sorry to hear that. I know how you feel. First, you should make a plan: write down all your tasks and start with the hardest one. Why don't you do your homework right after school, when you're not so tired? Don't study late at night, and you'd better not use your phone while you work. You shouldn't forget to sleep at least eight hours. Shall I help you with maths tomorrow? Write back soon!

tasks.prompt: Подготовьте устный совет на 1–1,5 минуты: «Как справиться с волнением перед экзаменом». Используйте should, shouldn't, had better, Why don't you…?, императив и Shall I…?. Здесь запишите план.
tasks.explanation: If you feel nervous before an exam, don't worry: it happens to everyone. You should prepare in advance and practise a little every day. Don't study all night, and you'd better go to bed early. Why don't you walk for fifteen minutes before the exam? Take a deep breath and think about something nice. You shouldn't talk to people who say the exam is terrible. If a friend is nervous, shall I help? Remember: a few mistakes are OK!
